name: How do local Colorado soil and climate conditions affect shower tile installation?

mainEntity.name: How do local Colorado soil and climate conditions affect shower tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Centennial, Parker, and across the Denver metro area, expansive soils and seasonal temperature swings cause residential foundations to expand and contract. This subtle structural shifting places stress on rigid building assemblies like tiled showers. Tile installers must incorporate flexible expansion joints at inside corners, where walls meet floors, and where tile meets dissimilar materials, using color-matched 100% silicone sealant instead of rigid grout. Additionally, uncoupling membranes and quality polymer-modified mortars help absorb subfloor movement, preventing floor and wall tiles from tenting or cracking during seasonal changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Colorado's expansive soils cause minor home movement, requiring flexible silicone joints at corners and polymer-modified mortars to prevent tile cracking.
